lines.cap: In 2017, a twenty year old invented the dumbest conspiracy theory ever. Then real people started believing it.
lines.say: In 2017, a twenty year old invented the dumbest conspiracy theory ever. Then real people started believing it.

lines.cap: The theory? Birds aren't real. The government killed them all, and replaced them with drone robots. To watch you.
lines.say: The theory? Birds aren't real. The government killed them all, and replaced them with drone robots. To watch you.

lines.cap: Why do birds sit on power lines? Recharging. Why do they poop on your car? Tracking device.
lines.say: Why do birds sit on power lines? Recharging. Why do they poop on your car? Tracking device.

lines.cap: It started as a joke. Peter McIndoe scribbled it on a sign at a protest in Memphis. Someone filmed it. It went viral.
lines.say: It started as a joke. Peter McIndoe scribbled it on a sign at a protest in Memphis. Someone filmed it. It went viral.

lines.cap: He built a whole fake movement. Billboards. Rallies. Merch. People screaming at birds.
lines.say: He built a whole fake movement. Billboards. Rallies. Merch. People screaming at birds.

lines.cap: And some people really believed it. That was the point. He was showing how easy it is to make a conspiracy feel real.
lines.say: And some people really believed it. That was the point. He was showing how easy it is to make a conspiracy feel real.

lines.cap: In 2021, he finally admitted it to The New York Times. He made the whole thing up.
lines.say: In 2021, he finally admitted it to The New York Times. He made the whole thing up.
